rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, this is Daniel from Sunrise Mill. I have your inquiry from last week about the 200 GSM twill 3/1 for the uniform program. I pulled the spec and we have something close — let me walk you through it.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Hi Mark,我是 Sunrise 织厂的 Daniel。你上周询的工装 200 GSM 3/1 斜纹我看了规格,我们有一个接近的 — 让我跟你过一下。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说有时间听,然后引导对方先说规格
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I am busy' — say 'I have 10 minutes, go ahead'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶沟通:给对方 talk through 的机会,显得有兴趣

rounds.ai_message: On the construction — the mill is a Toyota JAT810 air-jet loom. 190 cm reed width. We can run 110 ends per cm in the warp and 60 picks per cm in the weft. EPI / PPI 110 over 60. 200 GSM finished.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 织造配置 — 织机是丰田 JAT810 喷气织机。筘幅 190 厘米。经密 110 根/厘米,纬密 60 根/厘米。EPI/PPI 110/60。成品 200 GSM。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 问织机型号 + 转速 + 提花能力;问缩水率控制;问产量
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'Toyota is fine' — engage: '110 ends per cm is a tight construction. What's the loom speed? And can you do 2/1 twill too?'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶对答:问具体参数(loom speed, weft insertion rate)

rounds.ai_message: Loom speed is 720 RPM. We can do 2/1, 3/1, or 4/1 twill, and satin 4/1 or 5/2. For the 3/1 you need, our shrinkage control is 3% in warp and weft, post-sanforizing. Want me to send a 5-meter greige sample for hand feel?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 织机转速 720 RPM。可以做 2/1、3/1、4/1 斜纹,以及 4/1 或 5/2 缎纹。您要的 3/1,我们的缩水控制是经纬向 3%,预缩后。要不要我发 5 米坯布给您手感测试?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受 5 米试产,问缩水率标准(AATCC/ISO),问后整理
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'just send finished fabric' — ask for greige first to test the weave, then dye/finish separately if needed
rounds.tips_zh: 工装/工装面料:先 greige 测织法,后整理/染色再单独

rounds.ai_message: On the finishing — we can do singeing, desizing, scouring, bleaching, mercerizing (if you want the luster), then dyeing. Mercerizing adds 8% to the price but gives that cotton sheen. Which finishing route do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 后整理 — 我们可以做烧毛、退浆、精练、漂白、丝光(如果要光泽的话),然后染色。丝光会加 8% 价格,但能给那种棉的光泽。请问您要哪种整理路线?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 选不丝光/丝光;问染色工艺(连续染色/卷染);问色牢度等级
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'just normal finishing' — be specific: 'singeing, desizing, scouring, bleaching, pad-batch dyeing, no mercerizing'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:把每道工艺说出来,显专业

rounds.ai_message: Got it — singed, desized, scoured, bleached, pad-batch dyed, no mercerizing. Color fastness: wash 4, light 4, rubbing dry 4, wet 3. AQL 2.5. Lab dip in 5 days, bulk 30 days after your approval. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白 — 烧毛、退浆、精练、漂白、轧堆染色,不丝光。色牢度:水洗 4 级,日晒 4 级,干摩擦 4 级,湿摩擦 3 级。AQL 2.5。lab dip 5 天,大货您确认后 30 天。OK?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认色牢度等级可以,谈付款(LC/TT)和分批出运
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'great' alone — re-confirm: 'AQL 2.5, lab dip 5 days, bulk 30 days after approval, LC at sight, OK'
rounds.tips_zh: 定稿前:把数字重述一遍

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. Send me your Pantone code, the lab dip request form, and the target lab dip quantity. I'll have a 1-meter lab dip on your desk in 5 working days. Once approved, 30-day bulk. Lead time confirmed.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 完美。发我您的 Pantone 色号、lab dip 申请单,和需要的 lab dip 数量。5 个工作日内我把 1 米 lab dip 发您桌上。确认后,30 天大货。交期确认。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 承诺 1-2 个 Pantone + 5-7 米 lab dip 数量,确认发工艺单
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'ok' alone — 'Will send Pantone and lab dip form today. Looking forward to the lab dip.'
